LAW 9, STATED NOT NETTED: this board MINTS +8,385 SCAR = +1.2112% (692,296 -> 700,681), 41.9x the 200-SCAR band_scar rail. commit_message:
THE STAIRCASE FIX ADOPTED — ORDER 44, VARIANT B (smooth), ON THE OWNER'S WORD. The board moves 68be10c7 -> 219266fa (692,296 -> 700,681). LAW 9 BREACH ACCEPTED BY OWNER WORD, stated not netted.

OWNER WORD 2026-08-21, VERBATIM: "Happy to lock in 1.22% and variant B" — following his conservation
ruling ("The conservation law I don't like, especially in this case. It's 0.6% to fix a bug, it's
fine. Accept it."), which was given on a STALE PREMISE: the "0.6%" is the CONSERVED reading's board
BURN, not the mint. The supervisor re-presented the true measured RAW mint, 1.22%, and the owner
RE-CONFIRMED. THE RE-CONFIRMATION IS THE RULING OF RECORD.

LAW 9, STATED NOT NETTED: this board MINTS +8,385 SCAR = +1.2112% against a 200-SCAR (±0.029%)
band_scar rail — 41.9x. That is a BREACH ON ITS FACE and it is ACCEPTED BY OWNER WORD, recorded as an
ACCEPTED EXCEPTION and never as a pass. The conserved sibling (smooth+conserve, -4,169 / -0.602%) was
REJECTED by the same word. The adopted arm's own mint (+1.2112%) is marginally UNDER the 1.22% the
owner locked in, not over it — variant A raw is the +1.2220% arm.

WHAT THIS REPAIRS: register v806's LAW 3 (NO CLIFFS) VIOLATION. The five pinned quantile forests read
at conditional_prior.py:164-167 are piecewise-constant and carry no monotonicity constraint on the
level feature, so a player's band steps DOWN on a RISING level and 44 of 86 thin-evidence rows would
price HIGHER on a LOWER round-23 score. The four rows the fix exists for land at their measured
variant-B values: Kondogiannis 359->409, Dolan 247->311, West 381->382, Hayes 180->250.

THE LANE: the default literal in engine/rl_after/_merged_recover.py moves '0' -> 'smooth' and
data/model_config.json is NOT touched — so config_sha256 is UNMOVED and a canonical build can only
ship the baked-in default, never CARRY the name. conditional_prior.py is not edited, no forest is
refitted, cm_400.pkl and q97m.pkl are read exactly as they are. KILL-SWITCH: RL_O44_LVLMONO=0 restores
68be10c7 BYTE-EXACT, proved by build here, with the positive control that switch-off != switch-on.

SCAFFOLDING: classified for retirement at the end-of-season rebake per the owner's schedule.

OPEN LEG, DECLARED AND OWED: the no-arb tables and the rendered page were emitted for the CONSERVED
pair and the base, NOT for the RAW pair — the adopted arm's no-arb reading is NOT MEASURED. On the
conserved reading B put ND PRIMARY picks 11-20 over the +14% buy rail (12.71% -> 14.11%) and the raw
arms mint MORE, so the breach is EXPECTED to be more likely, not less. That is an expectation, not a
measurement. Named by the pricing seat in PACKET_STAIRCASE.md §0 and carried here unresolved.

LANDED BY tools/land lever (PLAN_v6 PACKAGE 2a) — ITS FIRST REAL LANDING. NOT PUSHED. Register v808
pending; the register is the supervisor's pen and is untouched.
